description: The authenticated user's compound growth plan (set on /journal?tab=stats): current capital, today's profit target and daily stop, today's realized P/L, plus weekly/monthly targets and progress to the goal. CALL THIS BEFORE PROPOSING OR PLACING TRADES and follow it: aim for at most today's target, and STOP trading for the day once today's P/L reaches the target (`status: target-hit`) or drops to minus the daily stop (`status: stop-hit`). Read-only. Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.
name: get_growth_plan
title: My compound growth plan
